name: Mirror layout
author: Lienzo UI
description: Flips the whole design horizontally (for right-to-left languages) or vertically, including anchors, text alignment and layout groups.

commands.name: Mirror horizontally (RTL)
commands.description: Left <-> right: positions, anchors, pivots, text alignment, rotation, shadows and horizontal layout groups.

commands.name: Mirror vertically
commands.description: Top <-> bottom: positions, anchors, pivots, vertical alignment, rotation, shadows and vertical layout groups.
